name: Lynae

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T0 Tower of Adversity, T1 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Spectro Pistols generalist Hybrid buffer, considered the best all-purpose buffer in the game - buffs almost any Main DPS via Outro (15% All DMG + 25% Liberation DMG Amplify) and Ultimate (24% party-wide DMG Bonus), plus Tune Rupture/Tune Strain toggle mode for specialized synergies (e.g. Mornye, Luuk).

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Chroma Drift (3 hits) / Kaleidoscopic Parade Basic (5 hits) once in Parade state.
skills.resonanceSkill: Lynae-Style Palettes (or Additive Color in Parade) - Spectro strike.
skills.forte: Chromaticity Modeling - governs Overflow -> Spark Collision -> Kaleidoscopic Parade -> Lumiflow -> True Color resource chain, culminating in Visual Impact (her main damage + 40 Tune Break Boost team-wide).
skills.liberation: Prismatic Overblast - Spectro hit, grants 24% All DMG Bonus to team for 30s.
skills.intro: Time to Show Some Colors! - Spectro hit, +25% Spectro DMG self-buff for 9s, restores 100 Overflow.
skills.outro: Let's Hit the Road! - Spectro hit + 15% All DMG / 25% Liberation DMG Amplify to next character for 14s or until swap.

bestWeapons: Static Mist (91.2%, better team buffing than her own sig in some cases)
echoSet: Pact of Neonlight Leap (best - 30% ATK + 10% DMG Bonus via Hyvatia to next character on Outro)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Aemeath is the single best pairing (Tune Rupture synergy); Mornye is Lynae's best Support partner (responds to Tune Rupture/Strain).

teams.name: Generalist Buff Teams
teams.notes: Works with virtually any DPS besides Zani and Cartethyia.

rotation: Intro (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Skill: Lynae-Style Palettes -> Heavy: Spark Collision (full charge, cancel via Jump) -> Jump: Polychrome Leap x3 -> Mid-air Attack: Visual Impact -> Outro. S6 uses a faster Heavy-Attack-first rotation.
communityNotes: Prydwen: the strongest generalist Hybrid buffer ever released, F2P-friendly (doesn't need signature), functions with nearly every DPS in the game with specialized Tune Rupture/Strain/Liberation synergies on top; main downside is a long-cooldown, low-flexibility single rotation with limited swap-cancel room.
